messages.subject: Gcc maven plugin help
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to compile some cpp with the gcc bridge maven plugin (https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/tree/master/tools/gcc-bridge/maven-plugin), and I got the example project (https://github.com/bedatadriven/gcc-bridge-example) working locally with the c sources it included, but when I dump cpp files in place of the c files, the plugin doesn't find them. I even tried moving src/main/c to src/main/cpp.

Does anybody have a project that uses cpp + the maven plugin that they could share? Or an example project where they manually compile the cpp files using the gcc bridge? Or, any advice in general about how to get it working?

Thanks,
Sam
